rationale: Most ground-truth concerns (scoping, dead seq_len param) are already resolved in the diff shown, so recall is inherently low for both; X's note that the split now keys solely on total_num_scheduled_tokens and 'drops the previous hidden-shape alignment' for any tensor whose dim aligns to hidden_states.shape[0] instead of scheduled tokens directly names the dual-batch-axis mechanism later fixed in PR #4910, earning gap_hit. Y is broader but noisier: it fabricates or overstates several 'major' findings (a test-object-identity doubt that X's own investigation refutes, a self-contradictory claim about _generate_audio_chunks both existing at cited lines and not being found by grep, and duplicated findings on lines 3509/3510 restating the same point), dragging precision down despite decent actionability and one plausible NPU-sibling catch.
